Production verification 2026-11-09 (operator-approved), on MCP build 0f409b946e4 (container rebar-mcp-0f409b946e4e-8093). A natural --all sweep at 10:48 PST found 0 of 10,088 tickets over the default threshold, so the sweep path was run with REBAR_COMPACT_THRESHOLD=9 and --limit=1 at 11:50-11:58 PST. It folded 029a-c2e8-b4af-44db (closed task, 10 events, had a prior SNAPSHOT):
compaction fold timing: ticket=029a-c2e8-b4af-44db outcome=folded attribution=20.73s signers=1.60s positions=149.28s lock_wait=0.00s recover=0.00s parse=0.00s reduce=0.00s ledger=0.00s build_snapshot=0.01s write_retire=0.00s commit=1.02s held=1.05s
The per-ticket history walk now runs before the lock (positions=149.28s, unlocked) and the ledger phase under the lock is 0.00s; held=1.05s against the ~181 s writer budget, versus 158-278 s on 2026-11-04 before the fix. The 149 s walk itself reflects the store's missing git maintenance, tracked as nickelic-lazuline-gonolek. Note: the single-ticket CLI (rebar store compact <id>) skips any ticket that already has a SNAPSHOT, so it could not exercise this path.
